details: Materials: Two identical glass prisms P1 and P2, Light beam source, Screen

branches.theme: Master Glossary, Definitions, Formulas, and Laws

details: Definition: The splitting of white light into its component seven colors (VIBGYOR) when passing through a glass prism due to wavelength-dependent refraction.
Application / Example: Red bends least, violet bends most.
evidence_or_examples: Red bends least, violet bends most.

details: Statement / Formula: Scattering Intensity is inversely proportional to wavelength raised to fourth power (1 / lambda^4).
Variable Definitions / Units: Shorter blue wavelengths scatter much more strongly than longer red wavelengths.
Model Application: Explains blue sky and reddish sunrise/sunset.
evidence_or_examples: Explains blue sky and reddish sunrise/sunset.
key_terms: Shorter blue wavelengths scatter much more strongly than longer red wavelengths.

details: Definition: The intrinsic electrical resistance of a conductor of unit length and unit cross-sectional area; SI unit Ohm-meter (ohm-m).
Application / Example: Metals have low resistivity (10^-8 ohm-m); insulators have high (10^12 ohm-m).
evidence_or_examples: Metals have low resistivity (10^-8 ohm-m); insulators have high (10^12 ohm-m).

details: Statement / Formula: V = I x R  ;  H = I^2 x R x t
Variable Definitions / Units: V = potential difference, I = current, R = resistance, H = heat energy, t = time.
Model Application: Calculates circuit parameters and thermal dissipation in heaters/fuses.
evidence_or_examples: Calculates circuit parameters and thermal dissipation in heaters/fuses.
key_terms: V = potential difference, I = current, R = resistance, H = heat energy, t = time.

details: Definition: A long cylindrical coil of many tightly wound insulated copper wire turns that generates a uniform magnetic field similar to a bar magnet when current flows.
Application / Example: Inserting a soft iron core inside forms an Electromagnet.
evidence_or_examples: Inserting a soft iron core inside forms an Electromagnet.

details: Statement / Formula: Stretch Thumb, Forefinger, and Middle finger mutually perpendicular: Forefinger = Magnetic Field, Middle finger = Current, Thumb = Force/Motion direction.
Variable Definitions / Units: F = B x I x L (Force on current carrying conductor in magnetic field).
Model Application: Determines rotation direction of electric motor armature.
evidence_or_examples: Determines rotation direction of electric motor armature.
key_terms: F = B x I x L (Force on current carrying conductor in magnetic field).

details: Definition: The phenomenon where non-biodegradable chemicals (like DDT) accumulate in progressively higher concentrations at successive trophic levels of a food chain.
Application / Example: Top carnivores (humans/birds) exhibit maximum toxin concentration.
evidence_or_examples: Top carnivores (humans/birds) exhibit maximum toxin concentration.

details: Statement / Formula: Only 10% of the energy available at a trophic level is transferred to the next higher trophic level; 90% is lost as heat/metabolism.
Variable Definitions / Units: Producers (10,000 J) -> Herbivores (1000 J) -> Primary Carnivores (100 J) -> Top Carnivores (10 J).
Model Application: Limits food chain length to 3-4 steps.
evidence_or_examples: Limits food chain length to 3-4 steps.
key_terms: Producers (10,000 J) -> Herbivores (1000 J) -> Primary Carnivores (100 J) -> Top Carnivores (10 J).
